ideas.pitch: A localized platform allowing student-run agricultural collectives to run micro-surveys and secure advance pre-orders, validating supply chain viability before investing capital.

ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses entrepreneurial problem-solving and real-world impact directly, which judges at an ideathon value over purely technical projects.

ideas.pitch: A platform facilitating inter-disciplinary and inter-collegiate student collaboration by matching complementary skill sets for startup teams.
